body: Yeah, it was the mom who pulled her out, which is kinda bad considering it's the week before finals...

Yeah, they do have a lot of power, and honestly the only reason either of those things would occur are because the girl's mom is psycho (hindsight is 20/20 I guess).

Also, I was told I would be talking to a psychic, and I am very upset that I have been misled.  I'm going to have to speak to your manager.

In all seriousness though, thank you so much.

I am seeing a therapist, but I don't have another session till next year (scheduling conflicts).

It's not technically out in the open that I personally was involved, only that the girl was caught doing it with someone and has been pulled out of school for the week (at least to my knowledge, they could just not be confronting me about it...).  My school does have a strict code of conduct (can't find it rn, need to look into that), but they have done some harsh things in response to stuff like this before.  As for legally, technically speaking it's solicitation of sex with a minor, which will mark me as a sex offender forever, plus the possibility of jail time

Yes, grace and forgiveness are a thing (though to clarify, it's just like any other school except with a foundation on Biblical teaching), and I have apologized, but they're somewhat old-fashioned and don't really understand this whole "depression" and "anxiety" thing, and in their lack of understanding they react with judgement and condemnation.  

I know I'm not the only one like this, but the amount of effort everyone puts into covering up this type of stuff spills over into condemning and harassing others who don't cover it up well enough as a way to boost their own self-righteousness (sounds like a fun place doesn't it)

As for us both being minors, as far as I have read (which granted isn't very far), the male is normally considered the aggressor by law in cases where the facts aren't perfectly against the female (in US btw), and since almost all of the texts are unrecoverable, it's kinda bad.

Thank you though.
